sbar.situation: The bank payment system has recovered. All components are at baseline and the payment journey passes end to end, confirmed clean on 2 checks in a row, the last at 28 s.
sbar.background: Just before the alert, the deployment pipeline changed the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600 seconds. This meant balance reads could be served stale for up to 10 minutes after a payment.
sbar.assessment: The root cause was a bad config on the gateway (confidence 0.9). The incident commander itself reverted gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 600 to 0.5, and the probe now shows the app balance matches the ledger.
sbar.recommendation: Find out why the pipeline set balance_cache_ttl_s to 600 and stop it reapplying that value. Operations should review payments and balance views from the stale-cache window, because customers may have seen balances that did not match the ledger.
